meta.subject: fixed L2 cache consecutive read miss bug fixed

en.summary: Fixes an L2 miss-path forward-progress bug by retaining a pending read request until the banked store accepts it, while also correcting banked-store row/index bookkeeping used by that path.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly names an L2 consecutive read-miss bug.
The substantive changes are in central L2 cache implementation files, especially `SourceD.scala` and `BankedStore.scala`.
The modified logic affects whether a miss-path read is retried, how the banked store indexes rows, and when bank conflicts apply backpressure.
disqualifiers: The commit also changes `Makefile` and test files.
A scheduler whitespace change and test updates are not part of the hardware bug itself.
evidence: `SourceD.scala` adds a `tobedone` register and changes stage-1 from `when (io.req.fire())` to `when (io.req.fire() || tobedone)`, so a request is retried if `io.bs_radr.ready` was not available on the first cycle.
`BankedStore.scala` changes `rowEntries`, `b.ready`, and `out.index`, indicating the banked-store geometry and acceptance logic were previously inconsistent with the multi-port organization.
The commit message names the failing scenario as consecutive read misses.
The mixed non-DUT changes are smaller than the L2 cache logic changes and do not explain the bug fix.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache miss pipeline that must issue a data-array or victim-line read cannot assume the array port will accept the request in the same cycle that the miss is dequeued. If the controller only tries once and does not retain the request for replay, consecutive misses can lose a required read side effect and either stall or return incorrect data. In banked arrays, the row index and ready decision must also match the physical bank grouping; otherwise the retry path can still address the wrong row or claim readiness too early.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: L2 miss read replay and banked-array request bookkeeping
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Back-to-back read misses, or any miss/read request presented when the banked data-array read port is not ready in the first arbitration cycle.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the pending-request replay latch so the miss-path read is only attempted on the initial upstream handshake, and optionally restore a simplified banked-array index/ready mapping that ignores part of the bank geometry.
portability_notes: The replay-latch removal is the primary portable mutation; the banked-array mapping regression is a source-grounded secondary mutation.
Apply the bug in the controller that turns a cache miss or read response into a banked data-array read before final response generation.
If the target DUT has no explicit banked ready decode, keep only the replay-latch mutation.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the stage that accepts a cache miss/read request and launches a banked data-array read or victim-line read.
Change that stage so it issues the downstream read only on the initial request handshake and does not remember the request if the array reports not-ready.

If the implementation separately computes bank select and row index, optionally collapse the row-index and ready calculation back to a simpler form that does not account for the full bank-group structure.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 `SourceD` stage-1 miss request replay and `BankedStore` row/index/ready calculation
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds `tobedone` so `SourceD` retries a request until `io.bs_radr.ready` is true, and changes `BankedStore` row geometry, `b.ready`, and `out.index` to match the banked organization used by the miss path.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove `tobedone` and the `|| tobedone` replay condition in `SourceD.scala`, and restore the older `rowEntries`, `b.ready := true.B`, and `out.index := a >> bankBits` behavior in `BankedStore.scala`.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Consecutive misses can drop or misroute a required banked-store read, leading to stuck miss handling, incorrect data return, or wrong bank/row access under contention.
evidence_for_injection: The new `tobedone` register exists solely to replay stage-1 work when the downstream read port was not ready.
The same commit adjusts banked-store address and ready bookkeeping, showing the bug was on the actual miss/read path rather than in tests.
The mixed Makefile and testcase edits are ancillary and do not change the core miss-path semantics.
notes: This commit was later refined by a follow-up fix, so confidence is medium rather than high even though the core patch is still a real DUT bug fix.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L2 miss 路径中的前进性缺陷：在 banked store 接受请求之前保留待处理读请求，同时修正了该路径使用的 banked store 行索引与地址组织逻辑。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出这是 L2 consecutive read miss 缺陷。
实质性修改位于核心 L2 cache 实现文件，尤其是 `SourceD.scala` 和 `BankedStore.scala`。
被修改逻辑影响 miss 路径读请求是否会重试、banked store 如何索引行，以及 bank 冲突如何施加回压。
disqualifiers: 该提交还修改了 `Makefile` 和测试文件。
其中的 scheduler 空白变更和测试更新并不是硬件缺陷本体。
evidence: `SourceD.scala` 增加了 `tobedone` 寄存器，并把 stage-1 的 `when (io.req.fire())` 改成 `when (io.req.fire() || tobedone)`，从而在首次 `io.bs_radr.ready` 不可用时重试请求。
`BankedStore.scala` 修改了 `rowEntries`、`b.ready` 和 `out.index`，说明 banked store 的几何组织和接受逻辑此前与多端口结构不一致。
提交信息把失败场景明确命名为连续读 miss。
混入的非 DUT 改动规模小于 L2 cache 逻辑改动，也无法单独解释该缺陷。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当 cache miss 管线需要发起一次数据阵列或 victim line 读取时，不能假设阵列端口一定会在 miss 出队的同一周期接收请求。如果控制器只尝试一次而不保留请求以便重放，那么连续 miss 时就可能丢失这次必要的读取副作用，最终导致停顿或返回错误数据。在 banked 阵列中，行索引和 ready 判定还必须匹配真实 bank 分组；否则即使存在重试路径，也可能访问错误行或过早宣称 ready。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: L2 miss 读取重放与 banked 阵列请求记账
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 连续读 miss，或者任意 miss/读请求在第一次仲裁周期里遇到 banked 数据阵列读端口 not-ready。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 移除待处理请求的重放锁存，使 miss 路径读取只在初始上游握手时尝试一次；如果 DUT 具有 banked 阵列，还可恢复一个忽略部分 bank 几何信息的简化行索引与 ready 映射。
portability_notes: 移除重放锁存是主要的可移植变异；banked 阵列映射回退是基于源仓库的次级变异。
应在把 cache miss 或读响应转换成 banked 数据阵列读取、并在最终响应前完成该读取的控制器中实施该故障。
如果目标 DUT 没有显式的 banked ready 解码，只保留重放锁存这一个变异即可。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位接收 cache miss/读请求并发起 banked 数据阵列读或 victim line 读的流水级。
将该流水级改成只在初始请求握手时发起下游读取；若阵列返回 not-ready，则不再记住并重试该请求。
如果实现把 bank 选择与行索引分开计算，可进一步把行索引和 ready 逻辑简化为不考虑完整 bank 分组结构的旧形式。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 中 `SourceD` 的 stage-1 miss 请求重放，以及 `BankedStore` 的行索引/ready 计算
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 `SourceD` 中加入 `tobedone`，使请求会重试直到 `io.bs_radr.ready` 为真；同时修改 `BankedStore` 的行几何、`b.ready` 和 `out.index` 以匹配 miss 路径使用的 banked 组织。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 `SourceD.scala` 中的 `tobedone` 及其 `|| tobedone` 重放条件，并在 `BankedStore.scala` 中恢复旧的 `rowEntries`、`b.ready := true.B` 和 `out.index := a >> bankBits` 行为。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 连续 miss 可能丢失或错误路由一次必要的 banked-store 读取，在竞争条件下表现为 miss 处理卡死、返回数据错误或访问了错误的 bank/row。
evidence_for_injection: 新增的 `tobedone` 寄存器唯一作用就是在下游读端口未就绪时重放 stage-1 工作。
同一提交同时修正了 banked store 的地址与 ready 记账，说明问题发生在真实 miss/读路径，而不是测试层。
混入的 Makefile 和 testcase 修改只是附带内容，不改变核心 miss 路径语义。
notes: 该提交随后还有一个后续补丁进一步完善，因此这里给出 `medium` 置信度，而不是 `high`。
